_comment: Documentation of what the OCI reader (oracle `oci`) decodes from the REAL committed image blobs. No spec check uses from:generated — the visual primitives read the parse tree / map probe directly — so these keys (all underscore-prefixed) are documentation the replay test asserts against the reader, never injected expectations. Every value is read off the real manifest/config/layer-tar; the content-addressable digest chain (oci-fidelity.test.ts) proves the blobs are unmodified.
